cues.en: In the previous lecture, we tested the user registration and activation routes on postman and everything was working as expected.
cues.zh: 上一堂課在 Postman 測試了註冊與啟用路由，一切正常。

cues.en: So moving forward for authentication needs, we're going to use a cookie based auth strategy using tokens to start us off.
cues.zh: 接下來的身分驗證，會採用以 Cookie 為基礎、搭配權杖的策略。首先，

cues.en: Let's first amend the config.py file so that you can add some settings that will be relevant to our custom JWT cookie.
cues.zh: 修改 config.py，加入自訂 JWT Cookie 所需的設定。

cues.en: So you can just close all this.
Then we're going to open the Config.py file within backend app core.
Then we're going to add some more settings.
So after the JWT algorithm right there we're going to specify the JWT access token expiration.
cues.zh: 在 JWT_ALGORITHM 後面，指定 JWT 存取權杖到期時間。

cues.en: So just at the bottom there we're going to say JWT underscore access underscore token underscore expiration underscore minutes.
That's going to be an integer type.
And we're going to default this to 30 if environment is local.
Else it's going to be a 15.
So we're defaulting this to 30 minutes if in local development.
cues.zh: 也就是本機開發時三十分鐘，

cues.en: Otherwise it's going to be 15 minutes in any other environment.
Then we're going to specify the JWT underscore refresh underscore token expiration in days that's going to be of type integer and are going to default this to one.
cues.zh: 再設定 JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRATION_DAYS，型別是 int，預設為 1。

cues.en: So this is the setting for the refresh token expiration time in days.
cues.zh: 這是更新權杖的到期天數。

cues.en: Then we're going to set a cookie flag, which is going to specify whether the cookie should only be sent over Https.
cues.zh: 接著設定 Cookie 旗標，指定是否只能透過 HTTPS 傳送。

cues.en: And so we can say cookie underscore secure is going to be a boolean type.
And we're going to default it to false in local development.
Then in staging or production environments we're going to set it to true.
cues.zh: staging 或 production 則為 True。

cues.en: So you can say is equals to false if environment is local.
Else it's going to be true.
Then we're going to set the cookie access name that's going to be of type string with the value of access underscore token.
cues.zh: 接著 COOKIE_ACCESS_NAME，型別為 str，值是 'access_token'。

cues.en: Then you're going to do the same for the cookie refresh name.
So you can say cookie underscore refresh underscore name.
That's going to be of type string.
And the value is refresh underscore token like that.
Then we're going to have three cookies in our application.
cues.zh: 應用程式會有三種 Cookie。

cues.en: We're going to have the access token the refresh token and the login cookie.
cues.zh: 存取權杖、更新權杖，以及登入狀態 Cookie。

cues.en: These are going to be explained as we build our application.
cues.zh: 建立應用程式時會逐步解釋，

cues.en: So don't worry.
So this is cookie underscore logged underscore in underscore name.
That's going to be of type string with a the value of logged underscore in like that.
Then we're going to set the cookie underscore HTTP underscore only that's going to be of type boolean with the default value of true like that.
cues.zh: COOKIE_HTTP_ONLY 的型別是 bool，預設 True。

cues.en: So when a cookie is set with the HTTP only flag, it means that the cookie cannot be accessed by JavaScript running in the browser.
cues.zh: Cookie 帶有 HttpOnly 旗標，表示瀏覽器中的 JavaScript 無法存取它。

cues.en: This is a security measure to prevent cross-site scripting attacks.
cues.zh: 這是降低跨站指令碼攻擊風險的安全措施。

cues.en: Then the next one we're going to say cookie underscore samesite is going to be of type string with the value of Luks like that.
cues.zh: 下一個是 COOKIE_SAMESITE，型別為 str，值是 'lax'。

cues.en: So this cookie samesite attribute specifies whether the cookie should be sent with requests to the same site.
cues.zh: SameSite 屬性指定 Cookie 是否隨同站請求傳送。

cues.en: By setting it to Luks.
This cookie is going to be sent with request to the same site, but not with requests to subdomains.
cues.zh: 講者將它說明為同站請求會送出 Cookie，但子網域請求不會。

cues.en: Then we're going to set a cookie path.
So cookie underscore path that's going to be of type string with the path being the root path like that.
cues.zh: COOKIE_PATH 的型別是 str，值是根路徑 /。

cues.en: So this cookie path basically means that the cookie is going to be available for the specified path.
cues.zh: 這個 path 表示 Cookie 對指定路徑有效，

cues.en: And it's up.
But in our case we are setting it to a slash, which means that the cookie is going to be available for the root path and it's sub paths.
cues.zh: 這裡設為 /，所以根路徑與其所有子路徑都適用。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a signing key for the JWT tokens.
cues.zh: 再加入 JWT 權杖的簽署金鑰。

cues.en: As you can see signing underscore key.
That's going to be of type string with the default value of an empty string.
cues.zh: 型別為 str，預設空字串。

cues.en: So this signing key is going to be used to sign the JWT tokens to make them tamper resistant.
cues.zh: SIGNING_KEY 用來簽署 JWT，讓權杖難以遭到竄改。

cues.en: Then after adding those settings we're going to open the dot env dot local file.
And we're going to add the signing key and the JWT secret key.
cues.zh: 加入 SIGNING_KEY 與 JWT_SECRET_KEY 的

cues.en: Environment variables.
So to generate those two environment variables we can use the Python Secrets module.
cues.zh: 可以使用 Python secrets 模組產生這些值。

cues.en: So you can go to the terminal.
Then we can say Python C import secrets.
Then secrets token URL.
Save 38 enter.
Then you can copy this value.
Then you can go back to the dot env dot local file.
Then after the salary related stuff we can just say signing key and we can set it to the value that we got from the Python Secrets module.
cues.zh: 在 Celery 設定後面加入 SIGNING_KEY，值就是剛才透過 secrets 模組取得的值。

cues.en: Then let me confirm the spelling of signing key.
It's signing key like that.
Then go back to the config.
It's signing key.
Make sure you don't misspell this because I tend to make this mistake at times.
cues.zh: 請別拼錯，我有時也會犯這種錯。

cues.en: But everything looks good.
And with that, that marks the end of this lecture.
In the next lecture we're going to be adding more utilities that are going to be used for our cookie based authentication.
cues.zh: 下一堂課加入 Cookie 驗證會用到的其他工具函式。
